primary_known_function: Neurovirulence factor ICP34.5; recruits host protein phosphatase 1alpha (PP1a) to dephosphorylate eIF2alpha, reversing PKR-mediated host translational arrest; blocks autophagy via Beclin-1 binding.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Infection maintenance; neurovirulence; overcoming host antiviral innate immune defenses.
relevant_literature_reference: Chou & Roizman (1990) J Virol 64:1014-1020; He et al. (1997) PNAS 94:843-848
notes: Non-structural leaky-late (gamma-1) protein with critical early-acting regulatory roles.

primary_known_function: RING-finger ubiquitin E3 ligase ICP0; induces proteasomal degradation of host restriction factors including PML and Sp100 in ND10/PML nuclear bodies to promote viral transcription and reactivation from latency.
documented_localization_or_compartment: Nucleus (ND10 nuclear bodies) early; translocates to cytoplasm late
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Immediate-early transactivation; overcoming intrinsic antiviral silencing; latency reactivation.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: PML, Sp100, USP7 (HAUSP), RNF8, p53, CoREST
relevant_literature_reference: Everett & Maul (1994) EMBO J 13:5062-5069; Boutell & Everett (2013) J Gen Virol 94:665-681
notes: Canonical alpha immediate-early regulatory E3 ligase.

primary_known_function: Envelope glycoprotein L (gL); essential chaperone forming a functional heterodimer with glycoprotein H (gH), required for proper gH folding, cell-surface trafficking, and viral membrane fusion.
documented_localization_or_compartment: Endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, virion envelope, plasma membrane
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Viral entry into host cells via membrane fusion; cell-to-cell spread.
relevant_literature_reference: Hutchinson et al. (1992) J Virol 66:2240-2250; Roop et al. (1993) J Virol 67:2285-2297
notes: Core entry machinery glycoprotein; gamma-1 expression.

primary_known_function: Uracil-DNA glycosylase (UDG); excises premutagenic uracil residues from viral DNA during replication to preserve genomic fidelity.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Viral DNA base-excision repair and maintenance of genomic stability in non-dividing neuronal cells.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL30 (DNA polymerase catalytic subunit), UL42 (processivity factor)
relevant_literature_reference: Mullaney et al. (1989) J Gen Virol 70:449-453; Caradonna & Cheng (1980) J Biol Chem 255:2293-2300

primary_known_function: Nuclear phosphoprotein UL3; modulates viral gene expression and capsid maturation.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Viral replication regulation; non-essential for viral growth in cell culture.
relevant_literature_reference: Baines et al. (1995) J Virol 69:825-833; Roizman et al. (2013) Fields Virology

primary_known_function: Nuclear protein UL4; participates in viral replication complex organization.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Late phase viral replication modulation.
relevant_literature_reference: Baines et al. (1994) J Virol 68:2929-2936; Roizman et al. (2013) Fields Virology

primary_known_function: Helicase subunit of the heterotrimeric helicase-primase complex (UL5/UL8/UL52); unwinds double-stranded viral DNA ahead of the replication fork with 5'-to-3' polarity driven by ATP hydrolysis.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Essential for viral origin-dependent DNA replication fork progression.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL8 (primase accessory subunit), UL52 (primase catalytic subunit), UL9 (origin-binding protein)
relevant_literature_reference: Crute et al. (1989) PNAS 86:2186-2189; Zhu & Weller (1992) J Virol 66:469-479

primary_known_function: Capsid portal protein; forms a ring-shaped homododecameric portal structure at a single fivefold vertex of the icosahedral capsid through which viral dsDNA is packaged and injected.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Essential for genomic DNA entry into preformed capsids during encapsidation.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL15/UL28/UL33 (terminase complex), UL19 (VP5 major capsid protein), UL26 (capsid protease)
relevant_literature_reference: Patel et al. (1996) J Virol 70:5206-5213; Newcomb et al. (2001) J Virol 75:10923-10932

primary_known_function: Tegument protein UL7; forms a functional complex with envelope/tegument protein UL51, required for efficient secondary envelopement, cytoplasmic virion assembly, and viral cell-to-cell spread.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Secondary envelopment and cytoplasmic maturation.
relevant_literature_reference: Tanaka et al. (2003) J Virol 77:1382-1391; Albecka et al. (2017) J Virol 91:e00897-17

primary_known_function: Helicase-primase accessory factor; essential subunit of the UL5/UL8/UL52 complex that stabilizes the complex, stimulates primase activity, recruits UL9 and ICP8, and targets the complex to the nucleus.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Coordination of helicase-primase assembly and replication fork recruitment.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL5 (helicase), UL52 (primase), UL29 (ICP8 single-strand binding protein), UL9 (OBP)
relevant_literature_reference: Crute et al. (1989) PNAS 86:2186-2189; Carmichael et al. (1993) J Virol 67:3520-3529
notes: Early (beta) replication complex member; computationally difficult due to large size and structural integration with replication core.

primary_known_function: Origin-binding protein (OBP); ATP-dependent 3'-to-5' DNA helicase that specifically recognizes and binds the palindromic sequences within HSV-1 origins of replication (oriS and oriL) to initiate replication bubble opening.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Initiation of viral origin-dependent DNA replication.
relevant_literature_reference: Olivo et al. (1988) PNAS 85:5414-5418; Elias et al. (1986) PNAS 83:6322-6326

primary_known_function: Envelope glycoprotein M (gM); eight-transmembrane domain glycoprotein that forms a disulfide-linked heterodimer with glycoprotein N (UL49A/gN), modulating membrane fusion and secondary envelopment.
documented_localization_or_compartment: Trans-Golgi network, plasma membrane, virion envelope
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Modulation of viral fusion activity and cytoplasmic envelopment.
relevant_literature_reference: Baines & Roizman (1991) J Virol 65:938-944; MacLean et al. (1993) J Gen Virol 74:975-983

primary_known_function: Small myristoylated and palmitoylated membrane-associated tegument protein (96 aa); binds membranes and acts as a central hub interacting with UL16 and UL21 to mediate secondary envelopment.
documented_localization_or_compartment: Golgi apparatus, trans-Golgi network, cytoplasmic membranes, virion tegument
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Secondary envelopment at cytoplasmic membranes; virion egress.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL16 (tegument protein), UL21 (tegument protein), gM (UL10), gE (US8)
relevant_literature_reference: MacLean et al. (1989) J Gen Virol 70:3147-3157; Baines et al. (1995) J Virol 69:825-833
notes: Late (gamma-1) protein; very short sequence (96 aa) and dual lipid modifications lead to distinct physicochemical features.

primary_known_function: Alkaline deoxyribonuclease (exo/endonuclease); promotes viral DNA recombination, branched replication intermediate processing, and concatemer resolution working cooperatively with ICP8 (UL29).
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Recombination-dependent DNA replication and genomic maturation.
relevant_literature_reference: Weller et al. (1990) J Virol 64:2890-2899; Martinez et al. (1996) J Virol 70:2075-2085

primary_known_function: Tegument-associated serine/threonine protein kinase; phosphorylates viral proteins (ICP0, ICP22, gE, gI, VP22, UL41) and host elongation factor EF-1delta, modulating transcription, translation, and tegument disassembly.
documented_localization_or_compartment: Nucleus and cytoplasm; packaged in virion tegument
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Phosphorylation of viral and host factors immediately upon viral entry; regulatory kinase.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: US1/ICP22, UL48/VP16, UL41/vhs, host EF-1delta, CDC25C
relevant_literature_reference: Overton et al. (1992) Virology 190:184-192; Cunningham et al. (1992) J Gen Virol 73:303-311
notes: Classified as Early (beta) expression, but packaged into virions to act as an immediate virion kinase upon infection.

primary_known_function: Minor tegument protein UL14; exhibits molecular chaperone-like activity, facilitates nuclear translocation of other tegument proteins, and promotes VP16/UL48 assembly.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Tegument organization and cytoplasmic maturation.
relevant_literature_reference: Cunningham et al. (2000) J Virol 74:33-41; Yamauchi et al. (2008) J Virol 82:10300-10307

primary_known_function: DNA packaging terminase large subunit 1; forms the catalytic ATPase/endonuclease terminase heterotrimer with UL28 and UL33, cleaving concatemeric viral DNA at pac sites and translocating DNA into capsids.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Essential packaging of concatemeric DNA into viral procapsids.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL28 (terminase subunit 2), UL33 (terminase subunit 3), UL6 (portal protein)
relevant_literature_reference: Baines et al. (1994) J Virol 68:2929-2936; Yu & Weller (1998) J Virol 72:7428-7439
notes: True late (gamma-2) terminase motor subunit; encoded by a spliced gene.

primary_known_function: Tegument protein UL16; acts as a structural bridge by binding UL11 at membranes and UL21 on capsids, orchestrating secondary envelopment.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Tegument assembly, bridging capsids to envelopment sites.
relevant_literature_reference: Nalwanga et al. (1996) J Virol 70:3077-3084; Chadha et al. (2012) J Virol 86:13589-13600

primary_known_function: Capsid-associated tegument complex (CATC/CVCR) subunit; interacts with UL25 at capsid pentons, essential for viral DNA encapsidation and stabilizing genome-filled capsids.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: DNA packaging and capsid stabilization for nuclear egress.
relevant_literature_reference: Salmon et al. (1998) J Virol 72:3779-3788; Taus et al. (1998) Virology 250:257-267

primary_known_function: Capsid triplex subunit 2 (VP23); heterotrimerizes with two copies of UL38 (VP19C) to form the triplex structures (1:2 ratio) that link hexon and penton capsomers in the capsid shell.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Assembly and structural stability of the icosahedral procapsid shell.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL38 (triplex subunit 1 / VP19C), UL19 (VP5 major capsid protein)
relevant_literature_reference: Patel & MacLean (1995) Virology 206:1106-1112; Dai & Zhou (2018) Science 360:eaao7298

primary_known_function: Major capsid protein (VP5, 149 kDa); primary structural building block forming 150 hexons and 11 pentons of the icosahedral capsid shell (960 copies per virion).
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Self-assembly into procapsids; virion structural integrity.
relevant_literature_reference: Costa et al. (1981) J Virol 38:483-496; Dai & Zhou (2018) Science 360:eaao7298
notes: True late (gamma-2) major structural hallmark; 100% correct in supervised classification.

primary_known_function: Multi-pass transmembrane envelope protein UL20; forms an essential functional complex with glycoprotein K (UL53/gK), required for primary envelopement at the inner nuclear membrane and secondary envelopment.
documented_localization_or_compartment: Nuclear envelope, endoplasmic reticulum, trans-Golgi network, plasma membrane
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Primary and secondary viral envelopment and egress.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL53 (glycoprotein K / gK), UL31/UL34 (nuclear egress complex)
relevant_literature_reference: Baines et al. (1991) J Virol 65:6414-6424; Ward et al. (1994) J Virol 68:7406-7414

primary_known_function: Tegument protein UL21; promotes microtubule-dependent retrograde and anterograde capsid transport in neurons and interacts with UL16/UL11 during envelopment.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Intracellular transport of viral capsids and secondary envelopment.
relevant_literature_reference: de Wind et al. (1992) J Virol 66:5200-5209; Benedyk et al. (2020) J Virol 94:e00898-20

primary_known_function: Envelope glycoprotein H (gH); core component of the conserved herpesvirus entry and fusion machinery, complexing with gL (UL1) to activate gB (UL27) during membrane fusion.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Viral entry and cell-to-cell fusion.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL1 (gL), UL27 (gB), host integrins and receptors
relevant_literature_reference: Gompels & Minson (1986) Virology 153:230-247; Chowdary et al. (2010) Science 327:606-610

primary_known_function: Thymidine kinase (TK); phosphorylates thymidine and deoxycytidine into dTMP and dCMP, and activates nucleoside antiviral prodrugs (acyclovir, ganciclovir).
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Salvage pathway pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis in quiescent neurons.
relevant_literature_reference: Wagner et al. (1981) PNAS 78:1441-1445; Summers & Summers (1977) J Virol 24:314-318
notes: Early (beta) metabolic enzyme and primary pharmacological drug target.

primary_known_function: Nuclear protein UL24; induces dispersion of nucleolar proteins (B23, nucleolin), modulates syncytium formation, and participates in nuclear egress.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Nucleolar morphology alteration; viral egress modulation.
relevant_literature_reference: Jacobson et al. (1998) J Virol 72:3325-3334; Lymberopoulos & Pearson (2007) J Virol 81:12564-12572
notes: Late (gamma-2) protein; non-structural regulatory role contributes to early-like computational classification.

primary_known_function: Minor capsid-associated tegument protein (CATC/CVCR); binds capsid vertices to anchor packaged viral DNA inside capsids and trigger nuclear pore docking for genome uncoating.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: DNA retention in capsids; genome uncoating at nuclear pores upon entry.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL17 (CATC), UL19 (VP5), Nup214 / Nup358 at host nuclear pore
relevant_literature_reference: Ali et al. (1996) J Virol 70:5258-5267; Pasdeloup et al. (2009) Traffic 10:1082-1092

primary_known_function: Capsid maturation serine protease (VP24/VP21); auto-cleaves to liberate the active VP24 protease domain which cleaves scaffolding proteins to permit DNA packaging into procapsids.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Procapsid scaffolding maturation and core evacuation.
relevant_literature_reference: Preston et al. (1992) J Virol 66:6489-6497; Robertson et al. (1996) J Virol 70:3717-3721

primary_known_function: Major capsid scaffolding protein (VP22a); self-assembles into an internal spherical scaffold that templates VP5 hexon/penton assembly into spherical B-procapsids.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Procapsid shell scaffolding assembly.
relevant_literature_reference: Preston et al. (1992) J Virol 66:6489-6497; Newcomb et al. (1996) J Mol Biol 263:432-446

primary_known_function: Envelope glycoprotein B (gB); class III viral fusion protein executing the ultimate lipid bilayer fusion step during entry and cell-to-cell spread.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Membrane fusion pore formation during host cell penetration.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: gH/gL complex (UL22/UL1), host PILRalpha, NMHC-IIA, myelin-associated glycoprotein
relevant_literature_reference: Heldwein et al. (2006) Science 313:217-220; Spear (2004) Cell Microbiol 6:401-410

primary_known_function: DNA packaging terminase subunit 2; bridges UL15 and UL33 and recognizes viral pac packaging DNA sequences for cleavage.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Viral DNA sequence-specific packaging.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL15 (terminase subunit 1), UL33 (terminase subunit 3), viral pac DNA
relevant_literature_reference: Tengelsen et al. (1993) J Virol 67:3470-3480; Yu & Weller (1998) J Virol 72:7428-7439

primary_known_function: Major single-stranded DNA-binding protein (ICP8, 128 kDa); coats ssDNA during replication, organizes nuclear replication compartments, and promotes strand exchange.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Core component of viral DNA replication machinery.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL30 (DNA polymerase), UL9 (OBP), UL12 (alkaline nuclease), UL5/8/52
relevant_literature_reference: Conley et al. (1981) J Virol 37:191-206; Weller et al. (1983) J Virol 45:354-366

primary_known_function: DNA polymerase catalytic subunit (136 kDa); executes high-fidelity 5'-to-3' DNA synthesis with intrinsic 3'-to-5' proofreading exonuclease activity.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Viral genome replication.
relevant_literature_reference: Gibbs et al. (1985) PNAS 82:7969-7973; Digard et al. (1993) J Virol 67:398-406

primary_known_function: Nuclear egress protein UL31; complexes with inner nuclear membrane protein UL34 to form the Nuclear Egress Complex (NEC), driving primary budding of capsids through the inner nuclear membrane.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Primary capsid envelopment and nuclear egress.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL34 (nuclear egress protein), capsids, host lamin A/C, protein kinase C
relevant_literature_reference: Chang et al. (1997) J Virol 71:8307-8315; Bigalke & Heldwein (2015) Cell 160:1107-1119

primary_known_function: Cleavage and packaging protein UL32; essential for viral DNA cleavage/packaging and capsid envelopment.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: DNA packaging and egress.
relevant_literature_reference: Lamberti & Weller (1998) J Virol 72:2463-2473; Roizman et al. (2013) Fields Virology

primary_known_function: DNA packaging terminase subunit 3; essential component of the tripartite terminase complex, stabilizing the UL15/UL28 interaction.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: DNA encapsidation motor function.
relevant_literature_reference: Beard et al. (2002) J Virol 76:4785-4791; Yu & Weller (1998) J Virol 72:7428-7439

primary_known_function: Inner nuclear membrane egress protein UL34; type II integral membrane protein complexing with UL31 to form the hexameric NEC lattice.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Primary capsid envelopment.
relevant_literature_reference: Roller et al. (2000) J Virol 74:117-129; Bigalke & Heldwein (2015) Cell 160:1107-1119

primary_known_function: Capsid vertex-specific protein (VP26); small protein decorating the outer tips of all 150 hexon capsomers (900 copies per capsid).
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Microtubule retrograde transport in axons.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL19 (VP5), host dynein light chains (DYNLT1/RP3, DYNLL1/LC8)
relevant_literature_reference: Booy et al. (1994) PNAS 91:5652-5656; Douglas et al. (2004) Nat Cell Biol 6:521-528
notes: True late (gamma-2) small outer capsid protein.

primary_known_function: Large tegument protein (VP1/2, 3,139 aa, 336 kDa); largest viral protein, serving as the master structural hub linking the outer capsid to the tegument and anchoring dynein/kinesin motors for axonal transport.
documented_localization_or_compartment: Capsid-tegument interface, cytoplasm, nuclear pore complex
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Retrograde/anterograde axonal transport, nuclear pore docking, genome injection, and secondary envelopment.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL37 (tegument), UL25 (CATC), host dynein/kinesin, nuclear pore proteins (Nup358, Nup214)
relevant_literature_reference: McNabb & Courtney (1992) J Virol 66:2655-2663; Sandbaumhuter et al. (2013) PLoS Pathog 9:e1003230
notes: Late (gamma-1) giant structural/regulatory hub (3,139 aa); classified as moderate-margin error (Delta p = 0.333).

primary_known_function: Tegument protein UL37; forms an obligate complex with UL36 at capsid vertices, required for directional axonal transport and secondary envelopment.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Axonal transport and secondary envelopment.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL36 (large tegument protein), host dystonin, cellular motors
relevant_literature_reference: Albright et al. (1999) J Virol 73:8000-8004; Coller et al. (2007) J Virol 81:11790-11797

primary_known_function: Capsid triplex subunit 1 (VP19C); forms the base of the triplex heterotrimer with two copies of VP23 (UL18).
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Procapsid assembly and capsid stabilization.
relevant_literature_reference: Patel et al. (1995) Virology 206:1106-1112; Dai & Zhou (2018) Science 360:eaao7298

primary_known_function: Ribonucleotide reductase large subunit 1 (ICP6, 124 kDa); converts ribonucleotides to deoxyribonucleotides (dNTPs) for DNA replication; contains an N-terminal RHIM domain that inhibits host necroptosis (RIPK1/RIPK3).
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: De novo dNTP biosynthesis and inhibition of host programmed necrosis.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL40 (RR subunit 2), host RIPK1, RIPK3, caspase-8
relevant_literature_reference: Preston et al. (1984) J Virol 52:102-109; Wang et al. (2014) Cell 152:1020-1032
notes: Early (beta) multifunctional metabolic and anti-necroptotic protein.

primary_known_function: Ribonucleotide reductase small subunit 2 (RR2, 38 kDa); forms the active alpha2-beta2 tetrameric holoenzyme with UL39/ICP6 containing the binuclear iron center.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: dNTP pool generation during viral replication.
relevant_literature_reference: Cohen et al. (1985) J Virol 55:289-299; Roizman et al. (2013) Fields Virology
notes: Early (beta) small subunit of ribonucleotide reductase.

primary_known_function: Virion host shutoff (vhs) endoribonuclease; packaged into the tegument and released into host cytoplasm upon entry to non-specifically cleave host and viral mRNAs, shutting off host protein synthesis.
documented_localization_or_compartment: Cytoplasm (mRNA decay sites) and virion tegument
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Immediate host translational shutoff and viral mRNA turnover.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: Host eIF4AI, eIF4AII, eIF4H, UL48/VP16, UL47/VP13/14
relevant_literature_reference: Read & Frenkel (1983) J Virol 46:498-512; Kwong et al. (1988) J Virol 62:912-921
notes: Late (gamma-1) expression, but functions immediately upon uncoating (high-confidence error Delta p = 0.352).

primary_known_function: DNA polymerase processivity factor (65 kDa); binds double-stranded DNA directly and forms a high-affinity stoichiometric complex with UL30 catalytic subunit to ensure processive replication.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Processive viral genome elongation.
relevant_literature_reference: Parris et al. (1988) J Virol 62:869-875; Gottlieb et al. (1990) J Virol 64:5976-5987

primary_known_function: Multi-pass transmembrane protein UL43; non-essential membrane protein involved in membrane fusion regulation.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Regulation of membrane fusion.
relevant_literature_reference: MacLean et al. (1991) J Gen Virol 72:897-906; Roizman et al. (2013) Fields Virology

primary_known_function: Envelope glycoprotein C (gC); binds host cell surface heparan sulfate proteoglycans (HSPGs) for initial attachment and binds host complement component C3b to inhibit complement activation.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Initial viral attachment to host cells; complement evasion.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: Cellular heparan sulfate proteoglycans, host complement C3b
relevant_literature_reference: Frink et al. (1983) J Virol 45:634-647; Kostavasili et al. (1997) J Virol 71:7450-7457
notes: Primary class Late; subclass annotated as Conflicting (gamma-1/gamma-2) in literature; strictly preserved.

primary_known_function: Envelope protein UL45; single-pass transmembrane protein involved in cell-to-cell fusion.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Modulation of viral membrane fusion.
relevant_literature_reference: Haanes et al. (1994) J Virol 68:5825-5834; Roizman et al. (2013) Fields Virology

primary_known_function: Outer tegument protein VP11/12 (UL46); activates host Src family kinases, modulates Akt and PI3K pathways, and cooperates with VP16.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Host signaling reprogramming and tegument delivery.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: Host Src family kinases (Lck, Lyn, Fyn), VP16 (UL48)
relevant_literature_reference: McNabb & Courtney (1992) J Virol 66:2655-2663; Wagner & Smiley (2011) J Virol 85:2804-2814

primary_known_function: Major outer tegument protein VP13/14 (UL47); shuttles between nucleus and cytoplasm, binds RNA, enhances VP16 transactivation, and modulates vhs (UL41) activity.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Enhancement of immediate-early gene expression and tegument assembly.
relevant_literature_reference: McLean et al. (1982) J Gen Virol 63:65-74; Donnelly et al. (2007) J Virol 81:2297-2308

primary_known_function: Major tegument transactivator protein VP16 (alpha-TIF, 490 aa); complexes with host HCF-1 and Oct-1 on TAATGARAT promoter elements to robustly transactivate all five viral Immediate-Early (alpha) genes.
documented_localization_or_compartment: Nucleus during early transactivation; cytoplasm during virion assembly
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Initiation of the entire viral transcriptional cascade upon entry.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: Host Oct-1 (POU2F1), HCF-1 (HCFC1), TFIID, TFIIB, UL41 (vhs), UL46, UL47
relevant_literature_reference: Campbell et al. (1984) J Mol Biol 180:1-19; Stern & Herr (1991) Genes Dev 5:2555-2566
notes: Expressed late (gamma-1), but acts at the immediate-early boundary upon delivery via tegument.

primary_known_function: Major tegument protein VP22 (301 aa); binds microtubules and viral mRNA, interacts with UL48 and UL16, and promotes efficient secondary envelopement.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Tegument bridge assembly and cytoplasmic secondary envelopment.
relevant_literature_reference: Elliott & O'Hare (1997) Cell 88:223-233; O'Regan et al. (2007) J Virol 81:13185-13195
notes: Late (gamma-1) major tegument protein; computationally difficult (moderate-margin error Delta p = 0.335).

primary_known_function: Envelope glycoprotein N (gN, 91 aa); small single-pass transmembrane glycoprotein that forms a functional disulfide-bonded heterodimer with gM (UL10).
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Secondary envelopment and modulation of membrane fusion.
relevant_literature_reference: Baines et al. (2007) J Virol 81:7805-7809; Roizman et al. (2013) Fields Virology

primary_known_function: Deoxyuridine 5'-triphosphate nucleotidohydrolase (dUTPase); hydrolyzes dUTP to dUMP to provide substrate for thymidylate synthase and prevent uracil misincorporation into DNA.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Nucleotide pool regulation and DNA replication fidelity in terminally differentiated neurons.
relevant_literature_reference: Caradonna & Cheng (1980) J Biol Chem 255:2293-2300; Wohlrab & Francke (1980) PNAS 77:1872-1876

primary_known_function: Tegument protein UL51; palmitoylated membrane-associated protein that binds UL7 to form a complex required for secondary envelopment and cell-to-cell spread.
documented_localization_or_compartment: Golgi apparatus, cytoplasmic membranes, and virion tegument
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Secondary envelopment and viral egress.
relevant_literature_reference: Nozawa et al. (2005) J Virol 79:9942-9950; Albecka et al. (2017) J Virol 91:e00897-17

primary_known_function: Primase catalytic subunit of the helicase-primase complex (UL5/UL8/UL52); synthesizes short RNA primers (8-10 nt) on the lagging strand during viral DNA replication.
documented_role_in_HSV1_life_cycle: Lagging strand primer synthesis during viral DNA replication.
documented_interactions_if_relevant: UL5 (helicase), UL8 (primase accessory subunit), zinc ions
